shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo ---- && ls -la && cat package.json && cat AGENTS.md && ls .agents/skills/gravity-ui/ && find .agents/skills/gravity-ui -type f | head -50

sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo ---- && rg -n -i -C 3 'dashkit|dashboard|grid' .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md | head -120 && echo ---- && ls src && cat src/* index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore && ls __agent_eval__ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui

npm install @gravity-ui/dashkit 2>&1 | tail -15; echo "---VERSION"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/package.json | grep -E '"version"|"peerDependencies"' -A 8 | head -30; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/

grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json; echo "--- DOCS"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/dist 2>/dev/null | head; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit -name 'INDEX.md' -o -name 'README.md' | grep -v node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/node_modules; echo "--- STYLES"; find node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build -name '*.css' | head; echo "--- TRAPS"; cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md

wc -l node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; echo "=== INDEX"; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/docs/INDEX.md; echo "=== README head"; sed -n 1,140p node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/README.md

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit; echo "=== exports"; node -e "const p=require('./$D/package.json');console.log(JSON.stringify(p.exports,null,1));console.log('main',p.main,'module',p.module,'types',p.types)"; echo "=== css import in esm"; grep -rn "\.css'" $D/build/esm --include=*.js | head; echo "=== index.d.ts"; cat $D/build/esm/index.d.ts; echo "=== typings"; ls $D/build/esm/typings/; echo "=== plugin types"; sed -n 1,200p $D/build/esm/typings/plugin.d.ts 2>/dev/null || grep -rln "defaultLayout" $D/build/esm --include=*.d.ts

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit; echo "=== css refs"; grep -rn 'css' $D/build/esm/components/DashKitView/DashKitView.js $D/build/esm/components/GridItem/GridItem.js $D/build/esm/index.js | head; grep -rln 'react-grid-layout' $D/build/esm --include=*.js | head -3; ls $D/node_modules 2>/dev/null; echo "=== components index"; cat $D/build/esm/components/index.d.ts; echo "=== DashKit.d.ts"; cat $D/build/esm/components/DashKit.d.ts; echo "=== ActionPanel"; cat $D/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null || cat $D/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.d.ts; echo "=== shared types"; cat $D/build/esm/shared/types/config.d.ts | sed -n 1,140p; echo "=== common"; sed -n 1,120p $D/build/esm/typings/common.d.ts; echo "=== uikit configure/Lang"; grep -n "Ru\|En\|export" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts | head -20

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit; echo "=== DashKit component d.ts"; ls $D/build/esm/components/DashKit/; cat $D/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.d.ts | sed -n 1,140p; echo "=== shared index / ItemDragProps ItemDropProps"; grep -n "ItemDragProps\|ItemDropProps" -A 12 $D/build/esm/shared/types/common.d.ts | head -60; echo "=== MenuItems constants"; grep -n "MenuItems" -A 8 $D/build/esm/constants/common.d.ts | head -20; echo "=== OverlayCustomControlItem"; grep -n "OverlayCustomControlItem\|OverlayControlItem" -A 14 $D/build/esm/components/OverlayControls/OverlayControls.d.ts | head -50; echo "=== pluginTitle/Text"; cat $D/build/esm/plugins/index.d.ts; echo "=== uikit configure"; grep -rn "export declare const configure\|export declare enum Lang\|Ru = \|En = " node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/configure.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/utils/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rln "configure" node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/index.d.ts node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/index.d.ts | head -3; echo "=== icons exist"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | head; for i in ChartColumn ChartLine TextAlignLeft Heading Pencil Check Plus Xmark ArrowsRotateLeft Gear LayoutHeaderCellsLarge Font LayoutSplitHorizontal Display Clock ListUl; do test -f node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/$i.js && echo "OK $i" || echo "MISSING $i"; done

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo "=== uikit configure/Lang"; grep -rn "configure\|Lang" $U/index.d.ts $U/components/index.d.ts | head; grep -rn "export declare enum Lang" -A 4 $U/components/utils/configure.d.ts $U/utils/configure.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head; find $U -name 'configure.d.ts' | head -2 | xargs sed -n 1,40p; echo "=== SetConfigItem/AddNewItemOptions"; grep -n "SetConfigItem\|AddNewItemOptions\|SetNewItemOptions" -A 10 $D/build/esm/typings/config.d.ts | head -60; echo "=== pluginTitle"; cat $D/build/esm/plugins/Title/Title.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; ls $D/build/esm/plugins/Title; echo "=== pluginText"; cat $D/build/esm/plugins/Text/Text.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40; echo "=== plugin constants"; cat $D/build/esm/plugins/constants.d.ts; echo "=== uikit Card/Progress/Label/Switch/Table props"; grep -n "view?\|type?\|size?\|theme?" $U/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head; grep -n "value\|theme?\|size?\|text?" $U/components/Progress/Progress.d.ts $U/components/Progress/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -12; grep -n "theme?\|size?" $U/components/Label/Label.d.ts | head -5; grep -n "checked\|onUpdate\|content\|size?" $U/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts $U/components/Controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8; grep -n "columns\|data:\|id:\|name?\|template?" $U/components/Table/Table.d.ts | head -12

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit; U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo "=== Title types"; cat $D/build/esm/plugins/Title/types.d.ts; echo "=== Title index (setSettings?)"; cat $D/build/esm/plugins/Title/index.d.ts $D/build/esm/plugins/Text/index.d.ts; echo "=== Text apiHandler usage"; grep -n "apiHandler\|setSettings" $D/build/esm/plugins/Text/Text.js | head; echo "=== PluginBase"; grep -n "PluginBase" -A 6 $D/build/esm/shared/types/plugin.d.ts 2>/dev/null || grep -rn "interface PluginBase" -A 6 $D/build/esm/shared/ ; echo "=== Card types"; grep -n "CardType\|CardView\|CardTheme\|CardSize" $U/components/Card/Card.d.ts | head -8; echo "=== Progress types"; grep -n "ProgressTheme\|ProgressSize\|size?" $U/components/Progress/types.d.ts | head -6; echo "=== Switch/ControlProps"; sed -n 1,30p $U/components/Controls/types.d.ts | grep -n "checked\|onUpdate\|onChange" ; echo "=== Table column align"; grep -n "align?" $U/components/Table/Table.d.ts | head -3; echo "=== DashKitDnDWrapper d.ts"; cat $D/build/esm/components/DashKitDnDWrapper/DashKitDnDWrapper.d.ts | head -30; echo "=== ActionPanel css vars check (dark ok?)"; grep -n "dashkit-action-panel-color\|position" $D/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.css | head -8

U=node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm; echo "=== Switch"; cat $U/components/Switch/Switch.d.ts | head -20; grep -rn "checked?\|onUpdate?\|defaultChecked?" $U/components/types.d.ts | head -5; echo "=== Dialog"; grep -n "onClose\|open\|size?\|Header\|Body\|Footer" $U/components/Dialog/Dialog.d.ts | head -12; grep -n "textButtonApply\|textButtonCancel\|onClickButtonApply\|onClickButtonCancel\|propsButtonApply" $U/components/Dialog/DialogFooter/DialogFooter.d.ts | head -6; grep -n "caption" $U/components/Dialog/DialogHeader/DialogHeader.d.ts | head -3; echo "=== TextInput/TextArea"; grep -n "value?\|onUpdate?\|placeholder?\|size?" $U/components/controls/TextInput/TextInput.d.ts $U/components/controls/types.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -8; grep -n "rows?\|minRows?" $U/components/controls/TextArea/TextArea.d.ts | head -3; echo "=== Text plugin no handler"; sed -n 70,82p node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/plugins/Text/Text.js; echo "=== GridItem css bg"; grep -n "background\|border" node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit/build/esm/components/GridItem/GridItem.css | head -8; echo "=== Label/Text variants"; grep -n "TEXT_VARIANTS\|'body-\|'caption-\|'display-\|'subheader-" $U/components/Text/text/text.d.ts | head -5

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit; grep -rn "cols\|rowHeight\|margin\|containerPadding" $D/build/esm/constants/common.js | head -10; echo "=== menu/overlay ru i18n"; ls $D/build/esm/i18n 2>/dev/null | head; grep -rn "DEFAULT_GRID_LAYOUT\|registerPlugins\b" $D/build/esm/utils/register-manager.js | head -5

D=node_modules/@gravity-ui/dashkit; sed -n 1,9p $D/build/esm/typings/config.d.ts; grep -n "reloadPlugins\|registerPlugins" -A 8 $D/build/esm/components/DashKit/DashKit.js | head -30; grep -n "_reloadPlugins\|reloadPlugins" -A 6 $D/build/esm/utils/register-manager.js | head -20; grep -n "ActionPanel\|margin\|containerPadding" $D/build/esm/components/ActionPanel/ActionPanel.css | head; grep -n "DEFAULT_NAMESPACE\|'default'" $D/build/esm/constants/common.js | head -3
rm -rf dist && git status --short && find src -type f | sort && grep -n dashkit package.json
